title: Last.fm Artist Repeat Ratio
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr/Radarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lastfm:scrobble
bin _time span=1w
stats sum(play_count) as plays, dc(artist) as artists by _time
eval repeat_ratio=plays/artists
description: Measures Last.fm listening diversity each week.
value: Surfacing last.fm artist repeat ratio helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant media, gaming & entertainment export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back when last.fm artist repeat ratio matters for your routine.
